findings.claim: Third-quarter 2026 revenue was $980.8 million, up 571% from $146.1 million a year earlier. Nebius AI cloud revenue was $973.8 million, up 643% from $131.1 million, and there was no partnership revenue in the year-earlier quarter.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group operating and financial review for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Income from operations was $50.4 million in the third quarter of 2026, versus a $130.2 million operating loss a year earlier. Group adjusted EBITDA was $465.8 million, and Nebius AI cloud adjusted EBITDA was $518.2 million.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group operating and financial review for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Net loss from continuing operations was $37.5 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared with a $119.6 million loss a year earlier. Interest expense was $112.5 million and induced conversion expense was $49.5 million.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group operating and financial review for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Nine-month 2026 net income from continuing operations was $393.3 million and included a $780.6 million gain from revaluation of the ClickHouse equity investment. That gain is presented in the nine-month column and was zero in the third-quarter column of the same statement.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group operating and financial review for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Nebius AI cloud revenue in the third quarter included $325.1 million from strategic partnerships. Management says those revenues are by their nature non-recurring and that the timing and amounts are hard to predict.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group operating and financial review for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Unsatisfied remaining performance obligations were $38.7 billion at September 30, 2026, fully attributed to the Nebius AI cloud business. The company expects to recognize 40% during the 24 months ending September 30, 2028 and 40% between months 25 and 48, and the figure excludes performance obligations with an original duration of one year or less.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, September 30, 2026

findings.claim: The shareholder letter says remaining performance obligations were $38.7 billion at the end of September 2026, up 3% from $37.5 billion at the end of June, and that customers committed more than $12 billion of contract value since the start of the third quarter.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group Q3 2026 letter to shareholders (Form 6-K Exhibit 99.2)

findings.claim: Nebius now expects 2026 revenue at the low end of its $3.0–$3.4 billion range, capital expenditure of approximately $27 billion, above its prior $20–$25 billion range, and annualized recurring revenue to exceed $7 billion for the month of February 2027, versus a prior guide of $7–$9 billion by December.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group Q3 2026 letter to shareholders (Form 6-K Exhibit 99.2)

findings.claim: The initial 2027 outlook in the shareholder letter is revenue of $12–$13 billion, pre-tax breakeven in the fourth quarter of 2027 after financing costs, and capital expenditure of $40–$45 billion, of which advanced prepayments and asset-backed financing of investment-grade contracts are expected to cover 75–85%.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group Q3 2026 letter to shareholders (Form 6-K Exhibit 99.2)

findings.claim: On September 8, 2025, Nebius Inc. agreed to give Microsoft dedicated GPU infrastructure at a new Vineland, New Jersey data center over five years. Subject to deployment and availability, total contract value is about $17.4 billion through 2031, or about $19.4 billion if Microsoft takes additional services or capacity, and Microsoft may terminate a GPU service if Nebius misses the agreed delivery date after a grace period and cannot provide alternative capacity.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group Form 6-K announcing the Microsoft GPU capacity agreement

findings.claim: Nebius now expects to have delivered more than half of the New Jersey capacity contracted with Microsoft by year-end 2026, with the remaining tranches scheduled for the second quarter of 2027, after DataOne began retiring temporary generation ahead of permanent power.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group Q3 2026 letter to shareholders (Form 6-K Exhibit 99.2)

findings.claim: In the third quarter of 2026, Customer E, Customer D, and Customer C accounted for 33%, 22%, and 15% of revenue, respectively. Accounts receivable, net rose to $4,039.9 million at September 30, 2026 from $720.3 million at December 31, 2025, and Customer D accounted for 75% of that receivable balance.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Under the ATM program for up to 25,000,000 Class A shares, established in November 2025 with sales commencing in May 2026, Nebius sold 4,633,800 shares in the third quarter at a $229.14 weighted-average price for $1,048.5 million of net proceeds, and 17,363,293 shares over nine months at a $225.10 weighted-average price for $3,859.6 million of net proceeds, leaving 7,636,707 shares available at September 30, 2026.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, September 30, 2026

findings.claim: On August 24, 2026 Nebius completed a $5.75 billion convertible offering, $3.45 billion of 0.50% notes due February 2030 convertible at about $313.46 per share and $2.30 billion of 4.50% notes due February 2034 convertible at about $324.65 per share. The September 30, 2026 debt table reports principal amount outstanding of $16,478.0 million and a carrying amount of $14,162.8 million, including accreted principal on those notes.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, September 30, 2026

findings.claim: On August 24, 2026 Nebius delivered 15,770,124 Class A shares in exchange for $800.0 million original principal of the June 2029 and June 2031 convertible notes and recorded $49.5 million of induced conversion expense. On March 11, 2026 it issued NVIDIA pre-funded warrants for 21,065,936 Class A shares for $2.0 billion of gross proceeds at a $0.0001 exercise price. On March 20, 2026 it issued about $4.34 billion original principal of additional convertible notes.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, September 30, 2026

findings.claim: On October 17, 2026 Nebius, Nebius Inc., and Nebius B.V. entered a bridge facility with Citibank for a $3.5 billion senior secured term loan to finance GPU-infrastructure buildout and general corporate purposes, maturing October 16, 2027, at Term SOFR plus a margin starting at 2.75% and stepping up to 3.50%, secured by substantially all of each borrower's assets and subject to a minimum liquidity covenant. The 6-K does not state how much was drawn.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group Form 6-K on the $3.5 billion Citibank bridge facility

findings.claim: Cash and cash equivalents were $7,425.6 million at September 30, 2026. For the nine months, continuing operations provided $4,231.1 million of cash, including a $7,829.0 million increase in deferred revenue; purchases of property and equipment and intangible assets were $15,430.7 million; and financing activities provided $16,618.0 million.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group operating and financial review for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Nebius subsidiaries are defendants in, or have received notice of, U.S. proceedings over zoning, permitting, and environmental compliance of data-center sites. Management says a loss is reasonably possible but, because the matters are early, cannot estimate the loss or range of loss.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, September 30, 2026

findings.claim: At September 30, 2026, 33,305,053 Class B shares with ten votes each were outstanding against 259,597,352 Class A shares with one vote each, and no Class C shares were outstanding. Those counts give Class B holders 333,050,530 of 592,647,882 votes, or about 56.2%.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Nebius says that, based on the expected path of its share price relative to the conversion prices, it currently expects a significant portion of its convertible notes to be converted into Class A shares rather than settled in cash, while the cash ultimately required depends on the future share price, conversion conditions, and holder elections.
findings.source_title: Nebius Group operating and financial review for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

upcoming_catalysts.event: Management expects annualized recurring revenue to exceed $7 billion for the month of February 2027, about two months later than the prior December target, before New Jersey is at full capacity.
Remaining Microsoft capacity tranches in New Jersey are scheduled for the second quarter of 2027.
Initial 2027 outlook calls for pre-tax breakeven in the fourth quarter of 2027, after financing costs, and revenue of $12–$13 billion.
The $3.5 billion Citibank senior secured bridge facility matures.

policy_links.policy: U.S. tariffs and export controls on servers, GPUs, and related equipment
policy_links.bottleneck: GPU and equipment availability, delivery timing, and pricing
policy_links.revenue_mechanism: The company says the timing of equipment purchases and capital expenditure depends in part on tariffs, export controls, and other supply-chain conditions. The filing does not tie a specific statute to a Nebius order or to recognized revenue.

key_risks.risk: Three customers were 33%, 22%, and 15% of third-quarter revenue, and one customer was 75% of $4,039.9 million of accounts receivable, so a delay or nonpayment by a large counterparty would hit reported revenue and cash collection.
Debt principal outstanding was $16,478.0 million at September 30, 2026, with a carrying amount of $14,162.8 million.

The October 17, 2026 Citibank facility is a $3.5 billion senior secured term loan maturing October 16, 2027, secured by substantially all of each borrower's assets, with a minimum liquidity covenant and a margin that steps up from 2.75% to 3.50%.

The ATM, the August convertible exchange, the March 2026 convertible issue, and the NVIDIA pre-funded warrants have already issued or committed tens of millions of Class A shares, and 7,636,707 ATM shares remained available.

Part of the Microsoft New Jersey deployment slipped to the second quarter of 2027, and 2026 revenue guidance was moved to the low end of the prior $3.0–$3.4 billion range because third-party capacity slipped into 2027.
U.S. zoning, permitting, and environmental claims over data-center sites are reasonably possible losses that management cannot yet quantify.

dilution_events_last_12m.description: ATM sales of 17,363,293 Class A shares during the nine months ended September 30, 2026, including 4,633,800 shares in the third quarter, for net proceeds of $3,859.6 million and $1,048.5 million, respectively, at weighted-average prices of $225.10 and $229.14. 7,636,707 shares remained available under the 25,000,000-share program established in November 2025.

August 24, 2026 issuance of $5.75 billion original principal of convertible notes: $3.45 billion 0.50% notes due February 2030 at an initial conversion price of about $313.46 and $2.30 billion 4.50% notes due February 2034 at about $324.65.

March 20, 2026 issuance of approximately $4.34 billion original principal of convertible notes: $2.59 billion 1.25% notes due March 2031 convertible at about $183.22 per share and $1.75 billion 2.625% notes due March 2033 convertible at about $180.31 per share.
August 24, 2026 exchange of $800.0 million original principal of the June 2029 and June 2031 convertible notes for 15,770,124 Class A shares, with $49.5 million of induced conversion expense.
March 11, 2026 NVIDIA pre-funded warrants to purchase 21,065,936 Class A shares for $2.0 billion gross proceeds at an exercise price of $0.0001 per share.

notes: The September 30, 2026 financial statements say they were prepared assuming the group will continue as a going concern and do not describe substantial doubt. Cash was $7,425.6 million, while nine-month purchases of property and equipment and intangible assets were $15,430.7 million and were funded by convertible notes, the ATM, the NVIDIA warrants, the term loan, and customer prepayments. The financial-statement note, separate from the operating-review cash-flow discussion, reports deferred revenue of $9,409.2 million at September 30, 2026 versus $1,577.5 million at December 31, 2025; the operating-review cash-flow increase in deferred revenue is $7,829.0 million. The Citibank 6-K authorizes a $3.5 billion facility and does not state how much was drawn. The debt-table principal of $16,478.0 million is accreted principal, higher than the original principal of the August 2026 and March 2026 notes. The Microsoft agreement was signed September 8, 2025, outside a strict trailing twelve months, and is included because the November 12, 2026 letter resets its New Jersey delivery schedule and the 6-K states the termination right for late delivery. Class B voting control is computed from the disclosed share counts and the ten-vote right. No delisting notice was found.
